subject: Request to reschedule our call
text: I hope your term is going smoothly, and I appreciate your flexibility with the timeline. Because a short client deadline has emerged, I would like to ask whether it might be possible to move our planned call to a slightly different day, if your schedule allows. I understand that office hours are limited and that you have several commitments at this point in the term, so I do not want to add any unnecessary burden. If it helps, I could offer a few alternative times that may be more convenient: Tuesday afternoon, Wednesday between two and four, or Friday morning after lunch. Any of those windows would work well on my end, and I am happy to join by video or telephone, whichever you prefer. I can also prepare a brief summary beforehand so that our conversation stays focused. Please let me know whether any of these alternatives fits your calendar. If none of them are feasible, I will gladly look at other openings and adjust my availability as needed. Thank you very much for considering the request and your patience too.
